description: Dream Company and Dream Job designators: toggle UI on job cards, visual badges, prominent display on company page, and backlog items for automated job alerts and dream jobs page.
steps: Update src/app/api/jobs/[id]/route.ts PATCH handler to accept dreamCompany and dreamJob boolean fields.

Update src/components/JobCard.tsx to: (1) show a star/heart badge next to company name if dreamCompany is true, (2) show a sparkle/star badge next to job title if dreamJob is true, (3) add toggle buttons for both fields that PATCH the job. Dream company badge: gold star with 'Dream Company' tooltip. Dream job badge: purple sparkle with 'Dream Job' tooltip. Visually distinct styling - dream jobs get a subtle gold left border or background tint.
Update the Job interface in src/app/jobs/page.tsx to include dreamCompany and dreamJob fields.
Update src/app/company/[slug]/page.tsx header area: if company.dreamCompany is true, show a prominent gold badge/banner 'Dream Company' with a star icon. The toggle should be easily accessible.

When a user toggles dreamCompany on a job, also propagate to the Company record (set Company.dreamCompany = true). When toggling off, check if any other jobs for that company still have dreamCompany=true before setting Company.dreamCompany=false.

Create src/app/api/jobs/[id]/dream/route.ts with a PATCH handler specifically for toggling dream status. Accepts { dreamCompany?: boolean, dreamJob?: boolean }. If dreamCompany changes, also update the linked Company record's dreamCompany field.

Append to BACKLOG.md: (1) 'Automated job alerts + auto-import for watched companies (dream companies)' under Job Management section, (2) 'Dream Jobs dedicated page - curated view of all dream company jobs and dream jobs' as a new item.
acceptance_criteria: Job cards show gold star badge for dream companies
Job cards show purple sparkle badge for dream jobs
Dream jobs have visually distinct styling (gold left border or tint)
Toggle buttons on job cards allow setting/unsetting dream status
Company page shows prominent dream company badge when flagged
Toggling dream company on a job propagates to the Company record
BACKLOG.md has new entries for job alerts and dream jobs page
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit code 0
